Sky over Silom--:--

Make more time for Bangkok

the Fah by Axis.Bangkok is a small boutique hotel in the heart of Silom. Walk to the street food and evening lights of Patpong Night Market or take a stroll to Lumphini Park. For plans further afield, BTS Sala Daeng and MRT Si Lom are both close by.

Explore rooms

Choose a cosy room for two, a penthouse with a kitchen and private balcony, or a family room with two or three bedrooms. Register online before you arrive for contactless check-in.

Silom

Silom on foot and by train

Patpong, Thaniya and Lumphini Park are all within a 17-minute walk. BTS Sala Daeng and MRT Si Lom take you to the rest of Bangkok.

  • 2minto Patpong Night Market
  • 7minto BTS Sala Daeng
  • 11minto MRT Si Lom
  • 13minto Lumphini Park

The hotel

Amenities and stay information

The hotel offers luggage storage, security staff and CCTV. There’s free Wi-Fi in the lobby, and our team can recommend places to eat and things to see in Bangkok. All rooms are smoke-free. A designated smoking area is available.

Register online before you arrive for contactless check-in. Everything is contactless, and our team is always in touch.
